headerDisplay:
## Vantage Controls
Configure your Vantage InFusion controller.

name.title: Name
name.description: A label for this platform entry. This is not the Homebridge platform identifier.

ipaddress.title: Controller IP
ipaddress.description: IP address of your Vantage InFusion controller. Leave blank to discover an InFusion controller using mDNS.

username.title: Username
username.description: Only needed if your controller requires login. If login is rejected or times out, discovery still continues.

password.title: Password
password.description: Only needed if your controller requires login. Used with Username.

forceSSL.title: Force SSL
forceSSL.description: Skip insecure ports and use 3010/2010 directly.

usecache.title: Use Local Cache
usecache.description: Maintain a persistent last-known-good configuration fallback while still attempting fresh discovery on startup.

includeLights.title: Include Lights and Loads
includeLights.description: Create HomeKit accessories for Vantage loads, dimmers, relays, RGB loads, fans (loads named fan), and similar switch/light devices.

includeBlinds.title: Include Blinds and Shades
includeBlinds.description: Create HomeKit accessories for Vantage blinds, shades, and window coverings.

includeThermostats.title: Include Thermostats
includeThermostats.description: Create HomeKit accessories for Vantage thermostats and HVAC zones.

includeSensors.title: Include Sensors and Contacts
includeSensors.description: Create HomeKit accessories for dry contacts, temperature sensors, light sensors, and Omni sensors.

omit.title: Omit VIDs
omit.description: Comma-separated list of Vantage object VIDs to skip.

range.title: VID Range
range.description: Include only VIDs within this inclusive range, e.g. 0-5000. Legacy comma format such as 0,5000 is still supported. If you have more than 140 accessories, add another VantageControls platform with a different range. On Homebridge 2, every extra instance must be a child bridge.
